data.title: bn-316s: rite channel takes over the launcher hook's pull attachment for the same agent
data.description: For bn-316s: edict's Claude hooks attach the agent as pull from SessionStart (edict bn-3oml), so the identity is held before the channel server exists and the channel found it already attached and refused. When attach is refused and the same agent holds a live pull attachment on a claude harness (read via rite sessions list), the channel retries with --replace for that attachment and holds occupancy itself; the placeholder is detached. A stream attachment is another channel server and is never taken over; another agent's cannot be (--replace already enforces same agent). Tests: takeover then delivery under the new identity; a stream attachment refuses the second server.

data.body: [risk:high] The takeover does not prove that the pull attachment belongs to this Claude process. pull_attachment_of selects any live pull attachment for the same agent and claude harness. The channel then replaces that attachment by id. A second Claude session that reuses an occupied agent identity can therefore displace the first session instead of failing closed. The new tests create only one intended placeholder and do not cover two distinct live Claude sessions. Failure modes: the second session steals agent:// occupancy while the first process remains live, so both can act or reply under one identity and work can route to the wrong session. Edge cases: a duplicate launcher, a stale terminal that remains live, simultaneous starts with the same AGENT, or a pull attachment created for a different Claude session. Rollback: stop the new channel and reattach or renew only the original attachment. Do not release unrelated occupancy. Monitoring: record the replaced harness session and reject a handoff without a process-bound match or unforgeable handoff token. Validation: start Claude session A with a live pull attachment, then initialize session B with the same agent but a different harness session. Assert B exits, A stays attached, and A keeps its claim. Also prove the intended same-session handoff still succeeds.

data.reason: [risk:high] BLOCK: src/cli/channel.rs:758-764 replaces any same-agent Claude pull attachment without binding it to this Claude process. A duplicate session can steal occupancy from a different live session. The risk:critical human-approval gate remains separate and unsatisfied.
